fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: An optional description of this resource.

fields.label: Http Keep Alive Timeout Sec
fields.help: Specifies how long to keep a connection open, after completing a response, while there is no matching traffic (in seconds).

fields.label: Proxy Bind
fields.help: This field only applies when the forwarding rule that references this target proxy has a loadBalancingScheme set to INTERNAL_SELF_MANAGED.

fields.label: URL Map
fields.help: A reference to the UrlMap resource that defines the mapping from URL to the BackendService.
